Zoe: Quick thread: final decision needed on form validation patterns for Console. Three quick Qs: 1) inline vs top-summary defaults, 2) required field signal (asterisk only vs visible label), 3) delete flow (undo snackbar vs typed confirm). Short takes pls. Hannah: Inline-first. Users expect field-level feedback. Top summary only when submit returns multiple errors or the form is long/multi-step. Liam: Agree. Suggest rule: if form has >=9 inputs or is multi-step -> show top summary on submit with anchor links. Otherwise inline on blur/submit. Sam: Accessibility: asterisk isn't enough. If we use '*', include an offscreen span "Required" and set aria-required on the input. Never rely on color alone. Olivia: UX compromise: hide visible "Required" text in dense/directory forms, keep sr-only. For onboarding wizards show visible "Required" helpers so new users see expectations. Zoe: Proposed defaults: inline validation (format on blur, presence on submit); top-summary for >=9 fields or multi-step submit errors; visual '*' plus sr-only "Required" everywhere; visible "Required" helper in low-density contexts. Hannah: Deletion patterns: single-item -> soft delete + undo snackbar. Bulk -> show count/scope and allow undo. Permanent/irreversible -> typed confirm (resource name). Liam: Edge-case: snackbar disappears on slow connections. Must also record action in Activity/Trash so users can recover for 30 days. Undo should be convenience, not the only recovery. Sam: Quick a11y snippets we should include in the pattern doc:
Please enter a name
Top-summary example:

We found 3 problems:

  • Email must be valid
Zoe: Microcopy suggestions: - Undo toast: "Moved to Trash — Undo" - Bulk undo: "Deleted 12 items. Restore from Trash within 30 days." - Typed confirm: "Type the project name to permanently delete: \"Org-Alpha\"" Olivia: Also recommend visual affordance for typed confirm: show resource name in monospace and require exact match (case-sensitive) for high-risk ops. Add a helper line: "This is permanent and cannot be undone." Hannah: Implementation note for Eng: server errors should return an array of {fieldKey, message, anchorId?} so client can populate top-summary and link to the field. Will draft payload shape. Liam: One more: analytics event for recoverability. Track undo clicks, recover from Trash, and typed confirm completions to understand failure modes. design-bot: Created task "patterns/forms/validation-required-delete" and linked to /design-system/issues/601. Zoe: Action items: Hannah to draft payload spec + examples, Olivia to compile a11y snippets and visible/sr-only variants, Sam to write 3 microcopy options for each toast/dialog, Liam to propose threshold (>=9) and anchor UX. I'll collate into the pattern doc and tag Eng. Target: PR for review by EOD Friday. Sam: Will post microcopy by tomorrow. Olivia: I'll add SR CSS snippet and contrast notes. Hannah: posting payload draft shortly. Zoe: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
